title: clistd configuration
description: Configuration for clistd lint rules and external adapters.

$schema.description: Filesystem path to this schema for editor integration.

ruleModules.description: ESM modules that export additional clistd rules.

rules.description: Rule severities and optional rule-specific settings.

clistd/no-similar-flag-names.description: Warn when flags in different commands have confusingly similar long names.

clistd/no-duplicate-documentation.description: Disallow identical summaries and descriptions on different CLI elements.

clistd/max-commands-per-topic.description: Warn when a topic contains more commands than the configured maximum.

clistd/require-cli-description.description: Require a description for the CLI.

clistd/require-topic-description.description: Require a description for every topic.

clistd/require-command-description.description: Require a description for every command.

clistd/require-argument-description.description: Require a description for every visible argument.

clistd/require-flag-description.description: Require a description for every visible flag.

clistd/require-json-flag.description: Require every command to support machine-readable JSON output with --json.

clistd/require-output-description.description: Require a description for every output contract.

clistd/require-success-exit-code.description: Require every command to document its successful exit code.

clistd/require-value-flag-value-name.description: Require value flags to declare a readable value placeholder.

clig/command-name-style.description: Require the CLI name to use lowercase letters and dashes only.

clig/standard-flag-names.description: Require conventional short names for standard long flags.

clig/prefer-flags-to-arguments.description: Discourage commands with multiple distinct positional arguments.

clig/no-secret-value-flag.description: Disallow value flags whose names indicate that they accept secrets.

clig/require-json-output-flag.description: Require a --json flag when a command declares JSON output.

clig/require-success-exit-code.description: Require commands to document exit code 0 for successful completion.

clig/require-failure-exit-code.description: Require commands to document a non-zero exit code for failure.

adapters.description: External adapters, keyed by ID or declared as an array.

maxCommands.description: Maximum number of commands allowed in a topic.
